senses.gloss:
ITA-7.1.3.7 dolāyantram दोलायन्त्रम्
Apparatus used for purifying substances by sudation or steaming

ITA-9.4.27 dolāśayanasaṁskāraḥ दोलाशयनसंस्कारः
Cradling ceremony
A ceremony in which the child is placed in a cradle for the first time; usually done on the 12th or 13th day following birth.
